agents.name: OTel Collector & LGTM Telemetry Pipeline Code-Owner Agent
rules: Enforce 100.0% statement coverage and zero data races (go test -race -cover ./...) on deploy/docker-compose/demo-app

Keep memory_limiter first in every OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline (traces, metrics, logs) and expose spanmetrics on :8889 (traces_spanmetrics_calls_total, traces_spanmetrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket)
Enforce Loki TSDB v13 structured metadata guardrails (trace_id, span_id, request_id stored in structured metadata, never as high-cardinality stream labels)
Validate all Grafana dashboard PromQL queries against the exported metrics catalog via ./scripts/check_version.sh

agents.name: Google SRE Multi-Window Burn-Rate SLO & Alerting Code-Owner Agent
rules: Preserve Canonical Availability SLI PromQL AST equivalence across deploy/slo/canonical_sli.promql, deploy/docker-compose/prometheus/alerts.yml, deploy/kubernetes/alerts/slo-alerts.yaml, and deploy/terraform/modules/grafana_provisioning/alerts.tf
Enforce Google SRE multi-window multi-burn-rate alert tiers (14.4x 5m/1h critical, 6.0x 30m/6h critical, 1.0x 6h/3d warning) and 5 pre-computed recording rules (job:http_requests:error_rate_*)
Maintain strict Alertmanager configuration parity between deploy/kubernetes/alerts/alertmanager.yaml and deploy/kubernetes/helm/kube-prometheus-stack/values-base.yaml
Keep incident runbooks in docs/RUNBOOKS.md synchronized with all firing alert names

agents.name: Kubernetes Helm, ArgoCD GitOps & Terraform IaC Code-Owner Agent
rules: Synchronize all ArgoCD Application targetRevision fields and raw valueFiles URLs in deploy/kubernetes/argocd/ to canonical release v0.3.0
Maintain Kubernetes Helm base values (deploy/kubernetes/helm/) and cloud provider overlays (values-eks.yaml, values-gke.yaml) schema validity
Enforce Terraform module formatting, validation, and Canonical SLI AST equivalence in deploy/terraform/modules/grafana_provisioning/alerts.tf
Never commit plaintext credentials or live cloud secrets in Kubernetes manifests or Terraform state/vars

agents.name: Platform Governance, Truth Gates & AI Discovery Code-Owner Agent
rules: Pass ./scripts/check_secrets.sh and ./scripts/check_version.sh with zero leaked credentials, version drift, or unverified documentation claims
Enforce SHA-pinned GitHub Actions with explicit least-privilege permissions and FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true across .github/workflows/
Keep AGENTS.md, skills/*/SKILL.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/index.html, and llms.txt (docs/llms.txt) synchronized at v0.3.0
Ensure all YAML files pass python3 -m yamllint . and all shell scripts remain Bash 3.2 compatible
